text.what: The pairing pinot noir gets asked about most: dark meat, a thick fat cap, and enough savoury weight to meet a wine with little tannin.
text.how: Roasted whole, seared as breast, or salted and cooked in its own fat as confit. Fat carries flavour and coats the tongue; a high-acid red cuts through it in a way a low-acid one does not.
